title: ResonateEngine host manifest
description: Written as resonate.host.toml at the repository root. States what the host provides before any module is loaded; a module may require these, and nothing may provide them again. Every field lives inside the single [resonate.host] table. Picked up by taplo through the #:schema first-line comment; cross-file checks stay in scripts/module_check.lua.

resonate.description: The engine namespace. A manifest has exactly one table in it.

host.description: What the host publishes before any module runs.

abi.description: Major ABI version the host publishes.

summary.description: One line describing what the host provides, including headless differences.

provides.description: Capabilities published by the host itself, before any module runs.

items.description: A capability id: 'Resonate' plus dotted PascalCase segments, as declared by CapabilityTraits in a capability header.
